name: Grive2
description: Backup your files to Google Drive using Grive2 client in a docker container - - Before you Start this Container: Go to https://github.com/agusalex/grive2Docker/wiki/Setup and follow the setup guide

paths.name: UNRAID_FOLDER
paths.description: Path to the unraid folder in which to sync the files, it also will contain .grive config file

variables.name: CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Your Client ID obtained by doing the procedure in the description

variables.name: SECRET
variables.description: Your Client Secret obtained by doing the procedure in the description

variables.name: CODE
variables.description: Your client secret obtained from the URL in the description Delete me after the setup is complete

variables.name: GRIVE_PARAMS
variables.description: Passes parameters to grive2. For example -s my_drive_folder. See https://github.com/agusalex/grive2docker#grive-settings

variables.name: CRON
variables.description: Crontab schedule to run this container, use this to generate it: https://crontab.guru/

variables.name: PERMISSIONS
variables.description: The UNIX permissions to apply to all files in the folder after sync. This will override any permissions you already have.
